book.method: All three staged page images were opened; equations and quoted Chinese text were read visually, not inferred from the corrupted text layer.
book.core_quote: 因此，当想要使用任意阵列进行空域非均匀采样时，该阵列需要满足什么样的条件才能保证不出现空谱混叠仍然是一个难题。
book.translation: Thus, when an arbitrary array is used for spatial nonuniform sampling, determining what conditions the array must satisfy to guarantee the absence of spatial-spectrum aliasing remains a difficult problem.

primary_sources.title: Uniqueness and linear independence of steering vectors in array space
primary_sources.observed_access: Primary DOI metadata/abstract and author's institutional record opened. Verified publisher resource and PDF returned HTTP 403. No original full theorem text was obtained.
primary_sources.matched_scope: Original primary abstract establishes steering uniqueness and linear independence conditions for linear, planar and general arrays. Tucker2022 explicitly attributes a necessary-and-sufficient all-direction integer-wrapping/linear-algebra test to its Theorem 6.
primary_sources.claim_limit: Reproduce the classical principle; do not assert exact 1981 theorem constants, boundary conventions, or detailed gains hypotheses from inaccessible full text. Linear independence of several source steering vectors is not the target solved here.
primary_sources.date_note: Crossref says 1981-08-01, consistent with volume 70 issue 2; institutional record uses a generic January 1 date.

primary_sources.title: Alias-Free Arrays
primary_sources.matched_scope: Noiseless narrowband single far-field source, isotropic sensors, half-wavelength coordinates, full-rank geometry; full-rank solution lattice is assumed for the basis/parallelepiped section. Proposition 3 gives arbitrary-direction-set translate disjointness; Corollary 4 gives the strict shortest-vector threshold 2.
certified_findings: Equation (11) checks only nonzero binary coefficient vectors, and is false for arbitrary bases (example E).
Corollary 5 checks all pairwise parallelepiped vertices, a stronger test than equation (11); its sufficiency claim is also false for arbitrary bases (example C).
Neither counterexample contradicts Proposition 3 or Corollary 4.
Full-rank real geometry can have a nonzero alias group of rank strictly below d; a full-rank parallelepiped is not automatically available.
primary_sources.publication_version_limit: Claims and formulas were checked against the open author manuscript, not a separately obtained publisher PDF.

primary_sources.title: Probabilistic analysis of ambiguities in radar echo direction of arrival from meteors
primary_sources.matched_scope: Arbitrary complex receiver gains, norm/phase-invariant perfect ambiguity through absolute normalized inner product 1, Section 2.1 equations (1)–(6), on nonzero response vectors.
primary_sources.not_covered: No exact global finite certificate for arbitrary gain functions. Normalization excludes blind zero-response directions. Their scattered gradient searches and simulations are not a proof of globally absent aliases.
